- **T-778** (4654) — Six more register-at-mount thread_local seams have no lifecycle guard — port the wave-129 idiom [ready] — MAJOR, found during wave 129's fix pass and filed rather than fixed because it spans four files outside that wave's owns. THE DEFECT SHAPE, proven twice in wave 129: a `thread_local` seam registered when a component mounts and never unregistered stays callable after the component dies. Backspace hide-chrome unmounts panels (mission_editor.rs, NO modal guard, and dialogs explicitly survive the hide), after which the stale closure REPORTS SUCCESS -- `true`, or a stale value -- while every `set` writes to DISPOSED signals, which reactive_graph 0.2.14 makes a SILENT NO-OP. A click reports success and does nothing: a dead click by lifecycle rather than by routing. TWO FAILURE MODES, and a naive fix closes only the first: (1) no unregister at all, so the stale hook answers forever; (2) an UNCONDITIONAL unregister, so a REMOUNT that installs before the dead component's cleanup runs is clobbered by that cleanup. VERIFIED BY THE ORCHESTRATOR 2026-08-08, `grep -c` per file -- each has register-at-mount seams and ZERO `ptr_eq` and ZERO `on_cleanup`: apps/website/frontend/src/ruler_tool.rs (RULER_CHAIN, 1 seam); apps/website/frontend/src/los_tool.rs (LOS_STATE, LOS_SAMPLER, VIEWSHED_STATE, 3 seams); apps/website/frontend/src/world_assets/mod.rs (register_render_ctx, 1 seam); apps/website/frontend/src/select_tool.rs (register_editor_selection, 1 seam -- this one is DOCUMENTED as deliberately leaking with the engine, so confirm the intent before changing it rather than assuming). THE FIX IS ALREADY WRITTEN AND SHIPPED TWICE -- port it, do not re-invent: `install_seam`/`unregister_seam` plus the `SeamRegistration` trait at apps/website/frontend/src/validation_panel.rs (wave 129, dac84b03) is the generic form covering four seams; eden_dock_right.rs's `install_select_zone` (f6a2b687) is the single-seam form. Register + `on_cleanup` unregister guarded by `Rc::ptr_eq` so only the LOSING registration is cleared. `on_cleanup` is Send + Sync-bound and `Rc<dyn Fn>` is !Send, so park the Rc in a `StoredValue::new_local` and read it back inside the cleanup -- cleanups run BEFORE arena nodes are removed, so the read is valid, and holding the clone keeps the allocation alive. DO NOT compare a bare `usize` address: the old Rc drops on re-register, so a later hook can be allocated at the freed address and a stale cleanup would wrongly clear it (ABA). For a signal-valued seam use the arena key `==` (slotmap versions its keys, so a recycled slot is not mistaken for its predecessor). ACCEPTANCE, three behavioural cases per seam, as wave 129 pinned them: install -> cleanup -> the read reports honest failure AND the stale hook is not called at all; install(A) -> install(B) -> A's cleanup -> B SURVIVES and still answers; never-installed -> honest failure. Perturb both ways: removing the cleanup must redden case 1, and removing the ptr_eq guard must redden case 2 ALONE -- case 2 is the one a naive fix gets wrong. WHY THIS IS URGENT RATHER THAN TIDY: in wave 129 a fix agent ADDED a new instance of this defect (validation_panel.rs `register_route_probe`) while a sibling agent was fixing the identical shape twelve lines away, and then made row clickability depend on it. The pattern is easy to get wrong and there was no shared idiom; now there is one. Audit every seam you touch and every seam you add.
